years: current model (Rodgers 2026 catalogue); successor of the Imagine 351
notes: Stop names are the American Eclectic engraving. The Organ Type piston switches every stop to English Cathedral, French Romantic or German Baroque voices (Voice Palette); the Library/MIDI A/B controls are not included.
359D, 359M and 359T are console variants (drawknob / tab) with the same stoplist.
MIDI channels: the keyboards always transmit on fixed channels Great 12, Swell 13, Choir 15, Pedal 14, whether or not a Library/MIDI coupler is on. Check on your organ.

Individual stop messages are not published. Pistons send either a Rodgers "STOP MAP" System Exclusive dump or a memory Program Change (set in the MIDI menu). Neither can be mapped to single stops, so every stop is unbound: use Learn every stop. If a stop sends nothing when you move it, it cannot be learned.
The controller sent by the expression shoes is not documented, so no expression mapping is set.
Stop list: https://www.rodgersinstruments.com/organs/imagine-series/imagine-359d (Rodgers product page, Stoplist tab, American Eclectic; the 359M and 359T pages show the same stoplist)

MIDI scheme: https://www.rodgersinstruments.com/uploads/downloads/1903011%20D00%20IMAGINE%20359%20OM.pdf (Rodgers Imagine 359 owner's manual, MIDI transmit channels table, PDF p. 34: Swell CH13, Great CH12, Choir CH15, Pedal CH14, fixed)
